p:cNvPr.descr: Two ball-and-stick models of ribofuranose rings. Carbons are gray balls and oxygens are red balls. In the left model, the 5' C bonds down to the 4' C, which bonds left and forward to the 3' C. This C bonds up and right to 2' C, which bonds down and right to the 1' C. 1' C bonds right to a base (boxed) and up and left to O. The position of the 2' C can change, as evidenced by the C-2' endo label inside the ring. A gray dotted ball and bond in the down position, in front of the molecule, is labeled C-2' exo. To the right, a similar structure is shown. This time, the moving carbon is C-3'. It is n the left and can be in the "up" position, labeled C-3' endo, or the "down" position, labeled C-3' exo.
